args.message: Invoice PIX-32121 (doc 5100003587, 35,830.00 USD) has a GR_MISSING payment block. No goods receipt exists for PO-48781 in the ERP. Receiving's 30 Mar note says all of last week's GRs were posted, so this one is either missing or was never booked. The only proof of delivery we have is Pinecrest's own email.
